notes.title: IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
Dear Crania Games followers, 
We are sorry to inform you that, our next title, A Way to be Dead 's release date has been postponed. 

Being a small independent studio, we have limited possibilities with internal testing. And with the desire to deliver our game to it's full potential for our whole player base to enjoy, we have decided to widen our release window to iron out any bugs and improve the game generally.

With this extra time before release, we will be running a closed beta that anyone can apply to and help us make the game better. Please stay tuned for the closed beta announcement, which will contain all the application details along with the application form.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your understanding and patience!

Crania Games
